title: PreorderCommandsBookingCommittedV1
description: 06 → saga signal (spec 11 §5.3, Inv-8): the spec-06 operation engine — which owns capacity (07), payment (09), and provider-create (06) for a pre-order operation — reached a terminal Booked outcome and, because the operation is marked IsPreorder, signals the saga instead of notifying the customer directly. On receipt the saga advances CommittingBooking → CommittingPreorder and binds the pre-order, then emits the single combined customer outcome. Routed to the 'preorder.processor' consumer; inbox-deduplicated and idempotent under duplicate delivery (Inv-5/Inv-9). Carries only opaque ids (Inv-12) — the saga is resolved by operation_id, so no saga_id is required.

operation_id.description: Owning booking operation id; the saga is looked up by this.

booking_id.description: Provider booking reference minted by the committed 06 operation.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.
